title: Simpler Software Metering setup and pages
summary: Software Metering now has its own Dashboard, Apps and Setup pages in the sidebar. Setup is three guided steps, and LicenseMeter finds the Intune Remediations package that runs the collector by itself, so you no longer pick a package. Because it reads the deployed script, it knows exactly which apps are watched and only asks for a collector update when new apps really are not watched yet. In the first weeks the dashboard shows coverage progress and recent app starts until the full charts have enough data, and the Apps page opens only the apps that still need a program file.
